ResearchTabDef.label: seabed research
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: What can only be learned on the sea floor itself. Seabed research cannot be done at a research bench: seafloor samplers set beside cold seeps, underwater volcanoes and hydrothermal vents gather it.

ResearchProjectDef.label: underwater survival
ResearchProjectDef.description: Drilling rigs to bore through the ice sea, and the basic techniques and life support that let colonists work and survive underwater.\n\nUnlocks the ice shaft, diving suit, watertight door, bilge pump and seafloor sampler. Further underwater technology needs seabed research, which only seafloor samplers can gather.

ResearchProjectDef.label: pressure engineering
ResearchProjectDef.description: Thick-walled structures that can hold back the water pressure below the thermocline, and pressure-rated decks laid over open water. Ordinary walls are slowly crushed at that depth; going further down means switching to a pressure-rated hull.\n\nUnlocks the pressure hull wall, the hull platform, the pressure deck, the pressuriser, and the platform pillar and ocean platform for building over the open sea.

ResearchProjectDef.label: submarine construction
ResearchProjectDef.description: Assembling pressure compartments into a submarine that can sail on its own. Once built, it can leave the ice shaft behind and travel to other parts of the ocean.\n\nUnlocks the keel frames, the submarine helm, the underwater thruster and the safety rope anchor.

ResearchProjectDef.label: abyssal navigation
ResearchProjectDef.description: The limits of what a hull and a crew can endure in the deep: magnetohydrodynamic propulsion that is almost silent, hard suits for leaving the hull at depth, and the pressurisation procedures needed before stepping out into the abyss.\n\nUnlocks the advanced underwater thruster and the pressure hatch.

ResearchProjectDef.label: underwater combat
ResearchProjectDef.description: Finding and fighting other vessels in the dark: sonar arrays that hear across the ocean, and the tactics of hiding behind the thermocline.\n\nUnlocks the active, passive and fire-control sonars, the torpedo tube, torpedoes and anti-torpedo torpedoes, the supercavitating point-defence gun, the moon pool and boarding craft, and the underwater rifle, whose range does not suffer underwater.
